description: This file contains asynchronous service functions for managing journal entries in a daily journal tracking application. It includes functions to create entries, fetch entries by date, list history, and compute user streaks, utilizing SQLAlchemy ORM for database interactions.

classes.name: DuplicateEntryError
classes.description: Custom exception raised when attempting to create multiple entries for the same user and date.

methods.name: JournalEntry create_today_entry( session: AsyncSession, *, user_id: str, content: str, today: Optional[date] = None )
methods.description: Creates a journal entry for today for a specific user, preventing duplicates for the same day.

methods.name: Optional[JournalEntry] get_entry_by_date(session: AsyncSession, *, user_id: str, entry_date: date)
methods.description: Retrieves a user's journal entry for a specific date.

methods.name: List[JournalEntry] list_history(session: AsyncSession, *, user_id: str, limit: int = 365)
methods.description: Returns a list of a user's journal entries ordered from most recent to oldest, up to a limit.

methods.name: int compute_current_streak(session: AsyncSession, *, user_id: str, today: Optional[date] = None)
methods.description: Calculates the current streak of consecutive days with journal entries for a user, ending today.
